cgx2-notebook: clean, pure scalar notebook file runner
Usage:
cgx2-notebook run INPUT.cgnb --out OUTPUT.cgnb [--project ROOT] [--edit-cell ID --source CG_CODE] [--timeout-ms N] [--force]
cgx2-notebook restart INPUT.cgnb --out OUTPUT.cgnb [--force]
cgx2-notebook delete INPUT.cgnb CELL_ID --out OUTPUT.cgnb [--project ROOT] [--force]
cgx2-notebook inspect INPUT.cgnb [--project ROOT]
cgx2-notebook show INPUT.cgnb CELL_ID
cgx2-notebook export INPUT.cgnb --out PORTABLE.cgnb [--force]
cgx2-notebook import PORTABLE.cgnb --out OUTPUT.cgnb [--force]
cgx2-notebook sweep INPUT.cgnb CELL_ID --value LITERAL [--value LITERAL ...] --out-dir DIRECTORY [--project ROOT] [--timeout-ms N]

Run starts a clean session, replaces saved code outputs, executes code cells in file order,
and saves fresh text/plain outputs. Inspect reads cell IDs, kinds, saved provenance and status
without executing. Only immutable bindings and pure scalar expressions are supported.
With --edit-cell, run first establishes clean scalar state, then recomputes the edit and its
transitive readers without rerunning independent cells. Show prints saved captured text and
provenance without executing. There is no side-effecting rerun or implicit overwrite.
